credits.title: Sapphire
credits.overview: Grieving the death of his mother, Sapphire struggles to understand a world that seems like it has changed forever. He spends his time in the worn out places along the Irish coastline, where he feels at home. While working at the docks one evening, his overwhelming grief manages to fracture the very laws of reality.

credits.title: The Weight
credits.overview: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.

credits.title: Collision
credits.overview: After a hit and run leaves a local teacher dying on a quiet road in the west of Ireland, a closeted hurler and an openly gay schoolmate go on the run together. As the town hunts for answers, the boys are forced to confront their guilt, their bond, and a love neither was ready to face.

credits.title: Terratoma
credits.overview: A trans woman tries to recreate a traumatic relationship for a film project.
